entries.current_limit: md5sum --tag output and tagged record handling are outside the current checksum manifest grammar and reject before input processing.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement tagged output/checking and escaping/filename/error-prefix semantics in pure MoonBit with standard digest vectors and pinned GNU manifest regressions; this is algorithm/format work rather than a public API gap.

entries.current_limit: The current Windows capability profile rejects numeric permission mutation and preserves the target file; this is separate from caller authorization.
entries.unlock_condition: Enable only with released public Windows permission semantics and independent Native/Wasm Windows mode/effect/error observations. Do not infer support from POSIX chmod or file-access authorization.

entries.current_limit: Symbolic-link creation is enabled only for POSIX in the current platform capability table; Windows ln -s rejects before creating or replacing the link.
entries.unlock_condition: Enable a Windows subset only after released public API/host creation and target-type/privilege/error behavior is identified and independent Native/Wasm Windows link/referent/replacement observations pass. A Native mv rename fix is not proof of ln creation support.

entries.current_limit: Bash-style array assignment is outside the bounded shell grammar and rejects as a syntax error before execution.
entries.unlock_condition: Keep this syntax rejected unless the supported shell grammar is deliberately extended with implemented array assignment/expansion/error semantics and independent declared-oracle tests. This is a language-profile restriction, not evidence of a missing async API.

entries.current_limit: tail supports following the already open descriptor but rejects -F path-follow/reopen because reliable replacement detection lacks public file identity.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public file identity plus Native/Wasm rotation/recreation/truncation/missing/unreadable/path-race and pinned GNU follow-name observations. Reopening a path alone does not prove replacement.

entries.current_limit: chmod --reference cannot read the reference file's current permission bits through the released public profile and rejects before mutation.
entries.unlock_condition: Lift only after released public mode reads support reference-mode selection and independent Native/Wasm permission, symlink, error-order and unchanged-on-failure regressions pass.

entries.current_limit: cp -p cannot preserve the requested source metadata through the current released public filesystem profile and rejects before creating a falsely preserved copy.
entries.unlock_condition: Lift only when released public metadata reads and required setters implement the requested preservation dimensions and independent mode/time/link/identity/error-effect regressions establish the Native/Wasm subset.

entries.current_limit: sort -R is recognized but rejected before input because the implementation lacks an audited GNU-compatible random-source/seed contract.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the selected GNU random-source consumption, hashing/order/equal-key/duplicate/exhaustion contract with source identity and independent byte/error evidence; an arbitrary PRNG shuffle does not lift this boundary.

entries.current_limit: touch -d timestamp assignment is outside the current timestamp-setting profile and rejects before creating a misleading output.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public timestamp setters and implemented selected date parsing/atime/mtime semantics with pinned GNU and Native/Wasm file-time/identity/no-content-mutation regressions.

entries.current_limit: Custom hexdump -e/-f format grammar is not implemented and is explicitly rejected.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the selected pure-MoonBit format grammar and read-count/repetition/address/character/number/empty-input interactions, then pass frozen util-linux byte/status regressions on Native/Wasm.

entries.current_limit: The current profile rejects forward -s skipping on stdin. Its existing seek-API diagnostic is broader than the capability actually needed for forward discard.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement checked forward reads/discards with empty/short/EOF/error-prefix and byte/status differentials. Only backward or end-relative positioning requires a proven seekable input or explicit spool; do not wait for a new seek API merely to support forward skipping.

entries.current_limit: Windows Wasm mv rejects source symlink/junction moves and destination-link backups before prompting or mutation; safe no-clobber/update-none and allowed regular-source replacement are separate checks.
entries.unlock_condition: Identify a released Wasm host containing the Windows rename fix, then pass independent Windows Native/Wasm file/directory symlink, junction, backup and unchanged-referent observations including held-open-stdin rejection and failure ordering. Missing host identity/privileges/observers remain infrastructure gaps, not successful or skipped acceptance.

entries.current_limit: od -tf4 floating representations are outside the current integer/character formatter and reject explicitly.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the frozen oracle ABI's selected float widths, endianness, special values and formatting/rounding in pure MoonBit, then pass independent Native/Wasm GNU byte/status edge cases; numerical implementation is not an async API gap.

entries.current_limit: csplit refuses an existing output name and preserves the pre-existing xx00 file rather than truncating or replacing an unowned file.
entries.unlock_condition: Require safe public handle identity/truncation and same-file alias/collision tests before supporting overwrite; retain ownership-bound partial-output cleanup and -k behavior.

entries.current_limit: fmt prefix selection (-p) is unimplemented paragraph-formatting work and currently rejects before output.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement prefix matching/preservation with margin, whitespace, width, long-word and paragraph interactions, then pass exact pinned GNU fmt Native/Wasm bytes/status regressions; no async API is required merely to parse this option.

entries.current_limit: Named-file decompression without stdout mode rejects in-place replacement and leaves compressed input and output paths unchanged.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public source metadata and safe replacement capabilities for the requested naming/mode/time behavior, plus fixed-GNU link/mode/collision/partial-failure regressions. Reader decoding and codec algorithms remain separate project work.

entries.current_limit: Named-file gzip operation without the supported stdout/no-name form rejects in-place replacement before modifying or removing files.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public metadata and safe replacement capabilities for source names/modes/times and fixed-GNU link/collision/failure-effect regressions. This does not defer implementable compression levels, Huffman selection or Reader decoding.

entries.current_limit: split uses exclusive new outputs and refuses an existing xaa without changing it or creating later pieces.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public handle identity/truncation and same-file alias/collision/failure-order regressions before accepting existing outputs; never use rename or guessed spelling as identity and never remove unowned files.

entries.current_limit: strings -e l is rejected; the current scanner only implements raw C-byte s/S encodings.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the selected wide little-endian decoding, minimum-length/offset/invalid-input and cross-block semantics, then pass pinned binutils Native/Wasm byte/status/partial-output differentials. Wide decoding is project work, not an async blocker.

entries.current_limit: Copying onto an existing destination with --no-preserve=mode and numbered backup is rejected because safe source/destination identity and overwrite effects are not established. The fixture's status 0 describes the upstream side; candidate execution still requires explicit nonzero rejection and unchanged state.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public identity/handle-truncation capabilities for the selected overwrite path, applicable metadata preservation, and fixed-GNU same-file/hard-link/numbered-backup/collision/failure-effect regressions on Native/Wasm before replacing this rejection.

entries.current_limit: patch refuses rewriting an existing pathname because the current public profile cannot preserve the source mode; unsafe in-place writes and default-mode inode replacement are both rejected.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public source-mode metadata and a safe mode-preserving replacement strategy, then pass fixed GNU mode/hard-link/mixed-failure and Native/Wasm no-damage regressions. Rename availability alone does not lift this boundary.

entries.current_limit: Named patch -o output is rejected because GNU output requires source permission preservation and public source-mode reads are unavailable in the current profile.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public source-mode metadata and safe new/replacement output semantics, with fixed GNU mode/link/collision/partial-failure and Native/Wasm file-effect regressions; --output=- remains a separate supported path.

entries.current_limit: Patch headers containing unsafe traversal paths reject before file access or mutation.
entries.unlock_condition: Preserve the no-escape rejection. Additional path forms require an explicitly reviewed safe path policy and no-outside-root/no-side-effect regressions; there is no automatic unlock from a new filesystem API.

entries.current_limit: An ambiguous local civil time in a DST fold is rejected instead of silently selecting an offset.
entries.unlock_condition: Open ambiguous local-time handling only with an explicit selection/disambiguation rule and independent pinned GNU/timezone transition fixtures covering both offsets, surrounding transitions and failure ordering.

entries.current_limit: A nonexistent local civil time in a DST gap is rejected as invalid; a timezone offset must not be guessed.
entries.unlock_condition: Retain rejection for nonexistent local times. Any explicit extension to conversion/disambiguation policy requires pinned timezone-transition and GNU byte/status fixtures before acceptance; no missing-public-API claim follows from this invalid-input rejection.

entries.current_limit: The date formatter rejects unsupported %q syntax instead of inventing output. This is formatter work, not an unavailable async API.
entries.unlock_condition: Extend the formatter only after the selected conversion/modifier has a defined C-profile implementation and pinned coreutils byte/status/invalid-format regressions; preserve pre-output failure ordering.

entries.current_limit: seq rejects an exponent below the documented -4096 bound to bound BigInt allocation; this does not impose a sequence record-count cap.
entries.unlock_condition: Raise the documented bound only with measured arithmetic/allocation behavior and pre-output error tests while preserving streaming sequence bytes; do not reinterpret a harness deadline as this product input limit.

entries.current_limit: seq rejects an exponent above the documented +4096 bound to bound BigInt allocation; this is a numeric input/resource limit, not a record-count or harness-timeout limit.
entries.unlock_condition: Raise the documented bound only after measured BigInt/resource behavior and pre-output overflow/error regressions justify it; retain streaming output and ordinary fraction/separator semantics. No public async API is the unlock.

entries.current_limit: mv -u cannot distinguish separate equal-mtime entries from a same-inode alias without public file identity and rejects the ambiguous identity-dependent operation.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public identity/handle metadata and independent Native/Wasm same-entry/hard-link/equal-time/symlink/backup/interaction/race regressions; content or timestamp equality cannot substitute for identity.

entries.current_limit: strings -e B is rejected as an unsupported wide big-endian encoding.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the selected frozen-oracle wide width/endian/length/offset/invalid-input behavior in pure MoonBit and pass independent Native/Wasm differentials before acceptance.

entries.current_limit: strings -e L is rejected as an unsupported wide little-endian encoding.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the selected frozen-oracle wide width/endian/length/offset/invalid-input behavior in pure MoonBit and pass independent Native/Wasm differentials before acceptance.

entries.current_limit: strings -e b is rejected instead of reinterpreting wide encoding as a single-byte mode.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement the frozen binutils wide big-endian mode with exact length/offset/invalid-input and streaming-boundary evidence before accepting it; do not approximate its meaning or use host delegation.

entries.current_limit: strings -e l remains an explicit unsupported wide little-endian mode.
entries.unlock_condition: Implement its exact endian/minimum-length/offset/invalid-input behavior and independent binutils Native/Wasm byte/status cases before widening the current raw-byte profile.

entries.current_limit: touch refuses timestamp updates to an existing file without rewriting its contents or replacing its identity. Status 0 in this fixture is the upstream expectation; candidate rejection remains mandatory.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public timestamp setters implementing requested atime/mtime semantics, plus independent Native/Wasm fixed-time, mode/identity, alias and no-content-mutation observations before enabling updates.

entries.current_limit: Windows Wasm mv rejects source symlink/junction moves and destination-link backups before prompting or mutation; safe no-clobber/update-none and allowed regular-source replacement are separate checks.
entries.unlock_condition: Identify a released Wasm host containing the Windows rename fix, then pass independent Windows Native/Wasm file/directory symlink, junction, backup and unchanged-referent observations including held-open-stdin rejection and failure ordering. Missing host identity/privileges/observers remain infrastructure gaps, not successful or skipped acceptance.

entries.current_limit: Patch creates new reject files exclusively; replacing an existing reject is refused before target/reject mutation because public handle identity and safe truncation are unavailable.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public identity/handle-truncation semantics and independent GNU Native/Wasm collision, alias, mode and partial-failure effects before replacing existing reject files.

entries.current_limit: Directory comparison of distinct character/block devices refuses because public device-number metadata is unavailable; FIFO/socket reports and top-level readable streams remain supported.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public rdev/device-number metadata and fixed GNU device equality/difference plus Native/Wasm effects before enabling this directory comparison.

entries.current_limit: Directory comparison of distinct character/block devices refuses because public device-number metadata is unavailable; FIFO/socket reports and top-level readable streams remain supported.
entries.unlock_condition: Require released public rdev/device-number metadata and fixed GNU device equality/difference plus Native/Wasm effects before enabling this directory comparison.
